correctness.rationale: The proof enumerates all supporting facets from the classical parity halfspaces and all possible pairwise intersections. Normal inner products give exactly two exterior dihedral angles; orthogonal simplex Gram determinants and the corner deletion formula give both ridge volumes. Polyhedral Steiner normalization then establishes the exact coefficient. The sharp R_5/R_6 crossover and monotonicity follow from D_{n+1}-2D_n=(n-3)(n-2)!>0. Independently checked actual Euclidean facet/ridge volumes and all pairs for n=4..7.
